data.narrative:
Sphere Semi is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Steven Glinert (CEO, ex-Kinta AI; Stanford MA Economics) and Mitchell Nahmias (CTO, Princeton PhD photonic integrated circuits; co-founder Luminous Computing). The company has raised $20M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, and SambaNova Systems.

Valuation triangulation was conducted using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given data constraints. The Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x applied to the $20M total raised proxy yields $50M. Peer-median analysis was not viable: while 12 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied minimum sample requirements (≥3 datapoints) across stage and valuation filters. Public-comp anchoring using the Semiconductors median P/S of 21.0x could not be applied due to absence of target revenue data, standard for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M–$57M, centered on $50M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries meaningful uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a single triangulation approach, absence of revenue visibility for direct comparables calibration, and the nascent stage of the target's development. The range is most defensible as a preliminary framework pending additional financial disclosure or further peer data maturation.
